lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters organized in a grid-like configuration posterior to the branchial region. The spots are arranged in approximately 5-6 identifiable horizontal tiers.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a matrix of anchor nodes where spots are positioned primarily within the grid intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal side and a shadow-induced drop-off on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Presence of distinct high-luminance blobs scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, though pixel density decreases towards the fin's apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Elongated, low-luminance feature (remora) visible trailing ventrally to the left pectoral fin and another smaller similar object visible in the lower-right quadrant.
